name: Mantis Shrimp Lord
body:
Mantis Shrimp Lord
CR 14

XP 38,400
N Large vermin (aquatic)
Init +6; Senses darkvision 60 ft., incredible sight; Perception +2

DEFENSE

AC 27, touch 15, flat-footed 21 (+6 Dex, +12 natural, -1 size)
hp 199 (21d8+105)
Fort +17, Ref +13, Will +9
Immune mind-affecting effects; Resist sonic 20

OFFENSE

Speed 50 ft.; swim 40 ft.
Melee 2 pincers +22/+17/+12 (3d6+8 plus grab and sonic burst)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 10 ft.
Special Attacks sonic burst, speedy pincers

STATISTICS

Str 26, Dex 23, Con 20, Int —, Wis 15, Cha 16
Base Atk +15; CMB +24 (+28 grapple); CMD 40 (52 vs. trip)

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Devastating Pincers (Ex)

A mantis shrimp lord can make iterative attacks with its pincers and ignores the first 20 points of hardness when attacking objects.

Incredible Sight (Ex)

A mantis shrimp lord’s eyes pick up colors well beyond those visible to humans, and it can see perfectly in all light conditions, including supernatural darkness. As long as the mantis shrimp lord is not blinded, it is treated as having blindsight 60 feet.

Sonic Burst (Ex)

A mantis shrimp lord attacks with such extreme speed that its pincers issue a concussive blast of light and force when they snap closed. Each time a mantis shrimp lord makes a pincer attack, whether it hits or misses, each creature in a 20-foot-radius burst centered on the attack’s target takes 2d6 points of sonic damage and must succeed at a DC 25 Fortitude save or be stunned for 1 round. A creature that succeeds at this save is immune to the stun effect from additional sonic bursts from that mantis shrimp lord until the vermin’s next turn, but it still takes sonic damage from additional sonic bursts. The mantis shrimp lord is immune to this effect. The save DC is Constitution-based.

ECOLOGY

Environment warm water
Organization solitary
Treasure none
